spec_features.spec_quote: If the model produces neither a tool call nor a finish, we prod it once, and end the rollout after N consecutive no-action turns
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:189-209: when _extract_tool_call returns None, consecutive_no_action+=1; if consecutive_no_action >= agent_cfg.max_consecutive_no_action_turns: transcript.ended_reason='stalled'; break. Otherwise a single prod user message ('You did not call a tool. Take exactly one action now...') is appended. Counter reset on action (agent.py:212). Default max_consecutive_no_action_turns=3 (config.py:65).
spec_features.notes: Both behaviors (prod once + end after N) are real and enforced; the break actually halts the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we consider it stalled and end the rollout.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:169 'for turn_idx in range(agent_cfg.max_turns):' with for-else at agent.py:244-245 setting ended_reason='max_turns'. max_turns default 30 (config.py:56).
spec_features.notes: The cap actually bounds loop iterations and ends the rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 30  # hard ceiling on agent <-> tool round trips

spec_features.evidence: tools.py _truncate() does head+tail (text[:half] + truncated marker + text[-half:]) and is called with max_output_chars on read_file (tools.py:163) and _from_harness output (tools.py:217); dispatch_tool is invoked with agent_cfg.max_tool_output_chars at agent.py:215. Default 6000 (config.py:62).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely applied to model-facing tool output, bounding context growth.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Broken harnesses can spew; we cap to keep the loop deterministic-ish and cheap.
